description: Auditoria local de prompts; não executa no Work Cloud.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,pathlib,runpy,sys; p=pathlib.Path.cwd(); s=next((a/'scripts'/'archive_prompts.py' for a in [p,*p.parents] if (a/'.codex'/'hooks.json').is_file() and (a/'scripts'/'archive_prompts.py').is_file()),None); (print(json.dumps({'continue':False,'stopReason':'Prompt archiver not found in this directory or its ancestors.'})),sys.exit(0)) if s is None else runpy.run_path(str(s),run_name='__main__')"
